How it works:
1. Pair your WH-1000XM6 (or XM5) with your phone 2. Select it from the dropdown above 3. Tap "Start Service" 4. When an allowed app plays media → ANC turns on 5. When it pauses → Ambient sound mode engages (level 1-20, optional voice focus)
The service runs in the background until you stop it.
To filter which apps trigger ANC, enable "Only trigger for selected apps" and choose them. For reliable app detection on Android 14+, enable notification access via the button above.
Protocol: MDR framing over Bluetooth RFCOMM (service UUID 956c7b26-…) Originally reverse-engineered by Gadgetbridge.

⚙️ SETTINGS
Ambient level: how loud ambient sound is when paused (1 = faint, 20 = loudest).

Focus on voice: keeps voices audible over ambient noise.
